concept: Recognizing risk and preparing a backup plan before committing to a course of action
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student plans for a realistic event (a presentation, a competition, a big ask) with a meaningful chance of not going as planned
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to prepare a backup plan
exercise.practice: Student identifies the single biggest risk and one concrete backup response

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic risk and a specific, realistic backup — not vague reassurance
